text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Three years running alongside Duramente... 
Shouldering all those hopes and feelings, 
she demonstrated her own version of "the 
strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Until I prove "who I am"... I can't afford 
to stop running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The time had finally come to use the "Hot 
Springs Trip Ticket" won from the lottery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, on the day Duramente left for the 
hot springs, I came out to see her off."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —Yeah. It's nice weather today.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I mentioned this when you won the ticket, 
but my family visits this hot spring 
resort quite often.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's the perfect reward for three years of 
hard work.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...? Glad?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "Aren't you going?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"No... to be fair, you never said a word 
about going yourself."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Still, until now... Wherever I went, I was 
always with you...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
..................I'm sorry, I just need a 
little time—
choice_data_list: I-I'm coming!! Just hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how unexpectedly shocked Duramente 
was, I hurriedly packed our things... and 
the two of us ended up arriving at the 
inn, but—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me.
choice_data_list:
You really don't need to apologize that 
much...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: However, it is truly shameful.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No matter what, I just couldn't hold back 
my feelings...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly sorry for practically dragging 
you along like this.
choice_data_list: I'm glad I got to come too!
I'm glad I got to come too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said that, Duramente will probably 
still let it bother her. So, I decided to 
invite her out for a change of pace.
choice_data_list:
Hey, looks like there's a hot spring town 
nearby.

Hey, it looks like there's a hot spring 
town nearby!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Huh... The sulfur smell is strong.
choice_data_list: Feels like a hot spring resort area

Feels like a hot spring resort area, 
doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Somehow it feels nostalgic... Like 
I saw it in a photograph long ago.”

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps Father and Mother also walked 
side by side like this once."
choice_data_list:
(Yeah, looks like she got a nice change of 
pace.)

(Yeah, looks like she got a nice change of 
pace.)

text_block_list.name: Hot Springs Town Local
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you two over there! First time 
around these parts?"

text_block_list.name: Hot Springs Town Local
text_block_list.text:
Then drop by the arcade over there. 
They've got plenty of retro games that are 
lots of fun.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Shall we play around a little before 
we go?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—...Tch, I missed...!? Trainer, one more 
time...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure, 70 of them! I'll make 
sure to sink those balls...!
choice_data_list:
(Well, they look like they're having fun, 
so whatever...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after thoroughly enjoying the hot 
spring town with Duramente, we headed back 
to the inn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I just wanted to hear your thoughts 
as soon as possible. How was it?"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I feel quite refreshed as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
No wonder everyone in the clan recommended 
it. I'll go take another soak later.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
How about... table tennis after this? I'll 
go a bit easy on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having spent a delightful time at 
the inn—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —It's about time to head home...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, Duramente's emotions 
were much easier to read than usual today. 
Remembering the expressions she showed me 
today—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Why are you laughing?
choice_data_list:
It was a day I got to see so many 
different sides of you.

It was a day where I got to see so many 
different sides of you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand it myself. 
...Still, though.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Having you know about it... makes me 
happy."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I think I... really want you to see it 
all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
The tension, the excitement. The sorrow, 
the joy... even the pathetic parts.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "I don't want to hide anything from you."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Our future continues on far into the 
distance."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
As the years pass, some things are bound 
to change. I'd like you to be there to 
watch over that as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Find the parts of me that even I don't 
know yet."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Duramente and 
myself...
